title: tab

messages.description: selects a tab and outputs its index
selects the tab with this label and outputs it
the selected tab: its index counting from 0, or its label in 'mode' 1

flags.name: -mode <float>
flags.description: nonzero outputs the label instead of the index (default 0)

flags.name: -labels <list>
flags.description: sets the tab labels, reading every symbol up to the next flag (default tab1 tab2 tab3 ...)

flags.name: -savestate <float>
flags.description: nonzero sets to save state mode (default 0)

flags.name: -activecolor <float, float, float>
flags.description: sets active tab color in RGB

flags.name: -fgcolor <float, float, float>
flags.description: sets text and divider color in RGB

flags.name: -activetextcolor <float, float, float>
flags.description: sets active tab text color in RGB

flags.name: -usetheme <float>
flags.description: nonzero uses Pd's theme colors instead of the colors set here (default 1)

methods.description: selects a tab without output, by index or label
sets all tab labels at once
sets one label (tab index and text)
nonzero outputs the label, not the index
sets active tab color in RGB
sets active tab text color in RGB
nonzero uses Pd's theme colors instead of the colors set here
nonzero sets to save state mode

body: [tab] is a row of tab buttons. Click a tab to select it and output its index, counting from 0, or its label in 'mode' 1. The tabs share the object's width evenly, so making the object wider gives every tab more room for its label.
